title: TIE: Training-free CLIP Embedding Guidance for Compositional Text-to-Image Alignment
title_zh: TIE：面向组合式文本到图像对齐的无训练CLIP嵌入引导

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have advanced notably, but still fail to satisfy prompt conditions, resulting in attribute mismatches and missing objects. These errors normally fall into two categories: concept loss , when an object or attribute (i.e., concept) goes missing, and concept confusion , when an attribute is assigned to the wrong object or multiple objects blend together. Recent studies suggest that these challenges are caused by the limited capacity of CLIP text encoder to capture fine-grained semantic details. Although several methods have been proposed, concept loss and concept confusion persist in recent T2I models when handling multi-object, multi-attribute prompts. In this paper, we conduct an embedding-level analysis to develop a training-free, inference-time solution for concept loss and concept confusion across CLIP-based T2I models. We find that (1) concepts mentioned later exhibit higher embedding entropy, reflecting less concentrated representations that are more often associated with concept loss, and (2) the first CLIP attention layer captures the strength of binding between each object and its attribute. Guided by our findings, we introduce TIE, a method that improves semantic alignment through a single text-embedding update. TIE addresses concept loss via entropy-aware singular value amplification and resolves concept confusion through interpolation–extrapolation binding based on CLIP attention scores, all in a training-free manner. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TIE enhances semantic fidelity in multi-concept scenarios with minimal sampling overhead. The project page is available at https://hong-sujung.github.io/TIE/ .
paragraphs.zh: 文生图（T2I）扩散模型已取得显著进展，但仍无法满足提示词条件，导致属性不匹配和对象缺失。 这些错误通常分为两类：概念丢失，即某个对象或属性（即概念）缺失；以及概念混淆，即属性被分配到错误的对象上，或多个对象融合在一起。 近期研究表明，这些挑战源于 CLIP 文本编码器在捕捉细粒度语义细节方面的能力有限。 尽管已有多种方法被提出，但在处理多对象、多属性提示词时，近期的 T2I 模型中仍然存在概念丢失和概念混淆问题。 在本文中，我们进行了嵌入层面的分析，以开发一种免训练的推理时解决方案，用于解决基于 CLIP 的 T2I 模型中的概念丢失和概念混淆问题。 我们发现：（1）越晚提及的概念具有越高的嵌入熵，反映出其表示更不集中，因而更容易出现概念丢失；（2）CLIP 的第一个注意力层捕捉了每个对象与其属性之间绑定的强度。 在这些发现的指导下，我们提出了 TIE，一种通过单次文本嵌入更新来提升语义对齐的方法。 TIE 通过熵感知的奇异值放大来解决概念丢失问题，并通过基于 CLIP 注意力分数的插值–外推绑定来解决概念混淆问题，整个过程无需训练。 大量实验表明，TIE 能够以极小的采样开销提升多概念场景下的语义保真度。 项目页面可访问 https://hong-sujung.github.io/TIE/ 。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation has advanced substantially through the development of diffusion models [ 28 , 33 , 9 , 35 ] , achieving notable performance in generating images from general prompts [ 33 , 35 , 30 ] . However, they continue to struggle with prompts involving multiple objects and attributes (e.g., color, shape), often resulting in semantic inconsistencies [ 30 , 7 ] . For example, given a simple prompt "a brown boat and a blue cat" , the generated image sometimes contains only a brown boat, or falsely depicts a brown cat and a blue boat. As prompt complexity increases, such failures occur more frequently and manifest in more varied forms.
paragraphs.zh: 文生图（T2I）生成通过扩散模型 [28, 33, 9, 35] 的发展取得了长足进步，在根据通用提示词生成图像方面表现出色 [33, 35, 30]。 然而，它们在处理涉及多个对象和属性（例如颜色、形状）的提示词时仍然存在困难，常常导致语义不一致 [30, 7]。 例如，给定一个简单的提示词“一只棕色的船和一只蓝色的猫”，生成的图像有时只包含一只棕色的船，或者错误地描绘出一只棕色的猫和一只蓝色的船。 随着提示词复杂度的增加，这类失败发生得更加频繁，并以更多样的形式表现出来。

paragraphs.en: In text-to-image (T2I) synthesis, the text prompt itself specifies the desired constraints on the output, in which objects should appear and which attributes should be bound to each object. Failures in controlled generation can therefore be viewed as violations of these prompt-induced constraints. For clear understanding, these failures can be classified into two categories: concept loss and concept confusion , as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Concept loss occurs when some of the intended objects or attributes specified in the prompt are missing from the generated image. This concept loss includes cases where objects appear without their corresponding attributes (Fig. 1 a) or where an object is entirely omitted (Fig. 1 b). In contrast, concept confusion arises when the binding between attributes and objects are incorrectly aligned. Such misalignment leads attributes to be assigned to unrelated objects (Fig. 1 c) or merges objects (Fig. 1 d). These failures indicate that even large-scale T2I models still struggle with multi-object and multi-attribute prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本到图像（T2I）合成中，文本提示本身规定了对输出所期望的约束，即哪些物体应该出现，以及哪些属性应该绑定到每个物体上。 因此，受控生成中的失败可以被视为对这些由提示引出的约束的违反。 为了便于清晰理解，这些失败可以分为两类：概念丢失和概念混淆，如图 1 所示。 当提示中指定的某些预期物体或属性在生成的图像中缺失时，就会发生概念丢失。 这种概念丢失包括物体出现但没有其对应属性的情况（图 1 a），或者物体被完全遗漏的情况（图 1 b）。 相比之下，当属性与物体之间的绑定被错误地对齐时，就会出现概念混淆。 这种错位会导致属性被分配给无关的物体（图 1 c），或者使物体被合并（图 1 d）。 这些失败表明，即使是大规模的 T2I 模型，在处理多物体和多属性提示时仍然存在困难。

paragraphs.en: Several studies [ 28 , 4 , 11 ] have attributed these failures to limitations in the textual representations used by T2I models. Although the widely used CLIP text encoder [ 29 ] provides rich textual representations, it often struggles to capture fine-grained details [ 43 , 37 , 44 , 19 ] . To address this limitation, previous works have proposed various strategies for improving compositional generation. Some methods directly manipulate text representations by merging tokens [ 15 ] , adaptively binding embeddings [ 47 ] , or iteratively optimizing them [ 5 ] , while others rely on additional supervision such as prompt parsing [ 11 ] . More recent approaches instead intervene during diffusion sampling, for example by rebalancing cross-modal attention [ 25 ] or steering flow-matching dynamics [ 3 ] . However, these methods either target specific compositional failures, require additional supervision, or introduce extra sampling-time computation. In this work, we perform a concept-level analysis of the CLIP text encoder and its embeddings to devise a unified and efficient solution to both concept loss and concept confusion.
paragraphs.zh: 多项研究 [ 28 , 4 , 11 ] 将这些失败归因于 T2I 模型所使用的文本表示的局限性。 尽管被广泛使用的 CLIP 文本编码器 [ 29 ] 提供了丰富的文本表示，但它常常难以捕捉细粒度的细节 [ 43 , 37 , 44 , 19 ] 。 为了解决这一局限性，先前的工作提出了各种改进组合生成的策略。 一些方法通过合并 token [ 15 ] 、自适应地绑定嵌入 [ 47 ] 或迭代地优化文本表示来直接操纵文本表示，而另一些方法则依赖额外的监督，例如提示解析 [ 11 ] 。 更近期的方法则改为在扩散采样过程中进行干预，例如重新平衡跨模态注意力 [ 25 ] 或引导流匹配动力学 [ 3 ] 。 然而，这些方法要么只针对特定的组合失败，要么需要额外的监督，要么引入额外的采样时计算。 在本工作中，我们对 CLIP 文本编码器及其嵌入进行概念层面的分析，以设计出一个统一且高效的解决方案，同时应对概念丢失和概念混淆问题。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we identify two indicators of concept loss and concept confusion. First, to address concept loss, we observe a positional bias in which concepts appearing later in the prompt are more likely to be omitted in the generated image. Based on this finding, we look for a quantitative measure which estimates the likelihood of concept loss. Through various observations, we find that token entropy , the entropy of each token embedding, reflects how diffusely its information is distributed and serves as a proxy of concept loss. Second, to mitigate concept confusion, we look into the first layer attention scores of the CLIP text encoder, referred to as L0 attention scores . We demonstrate that L0 attention scores effectively show the strength of binding between concept tokens and how much it should be strengthened to reduce concept confusion. These two indicators are associated with both concept loss and concept confusion using only the internal mechanisms of the CLIP text encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 为了应对这些挑战，我们确定了概念丢失和概念混淆的两个指标。 首先，为了解决概念丢失问题，我们观察到一种位置偏差，即在提示词中越晚出现的概念越容易在生成图像中被遗漏。 基于这一发现，我们寻找一种能够估计概念丢失可能性的量化度量。 通过多种观察，我们发现词元熵（token entropy），即每个词元嵌入的熵，反映了其信息分布的分散程度，并可作为概念丢失的代理指标。 其次，为了缓解概念混淆，我们研究了CLIP文本编码器的第一层注意力分数，称为L0注意力分数（L0 attention scores）。 我们证明，L0注意力分数能够有效显示概念词元之间绑定的强度，以及需要增强多少才能减少概念混淆。 这两个指标仅利用CLIP文本编码器的内部机制，即可同时关联概念丢失和概念混淆。

paragraphs.en: Based on our findings, we propose two methods to address the limitations of T2I models: Adaptive Embedding Preservation (AEP) for mitigating concept loss, and Interpolation-Extrapolation Binding (IEB) for resolving concept confusion. AEP adaptively amplifies tokens according to token entropy to encourage their presence in the generated image. IEB enhances the semantic binding strength between objects and their corresponding attributes based on the L0 layer, while simultaneously suppressing the binding strength of irrelevant attribute-object pairs. We refer to the combined framework of AEP and IEB as TIE . TIE improves text-image semantic alignment across multi-attribute and multi-object scenarios. Our method updates text embeddings in a single step without training, making it readily applicable to existing CLIP-based T2I models while improving semantic fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 基于我们的发现，我们提出两种方法来解决文生图（T2I）模型的局限性：自适应嵌入保留（AEP）用于缓解概念丢失，插值-外推绑定（IEB）用于解决概念混淆。 AEP 根据 token 熵自适应地放大 token，以促使它们出现在生成的图像中。 IEB 在 L0 层的基础上增强对象与其对应属性之间的语义绑定强度，同时抑制无关属性-对象对的绑定强度。 我们将 AEP 与 IEB 的组合框架称为 TIE。 TIE 在多属性和多对象场景中提升了文本-图像的语义对齐。 我们的方法在单步中更新文本嵌入且无需训练，因此可以直接应用于现有的基于 CLIP 的 T2I 模型，同时提升语义保真度。

sents.zh: 我们将 AEP 与 IEB 的组合框架称为 TIE。

sents.en: TIE improves text-image semantic alignment across multi-attribute and multi-object scenarios.
sents.zh: TIE 在多属性和多对象场景中提升了文本-图像的语义对齐。

sents.en: Our method updates text embeddings in a single step without training, making it readily applicable to existing CLIP-based T2I models while improving semantic fidelity.
sents.zh: 我们的方法在单步中更新文本嵌入且无需训练，因此可以直接应用于现有的基于 CLIP 的 T2I 模型，同时提升语义保真度。

paragraphs.en: We identify two indicators that jointly address concept loss and concept confusion. First, token entropy captures how concentrated each token representation is and provides a useful cue for mitigating concept loss. Secondly, the L0 attention score effectively captures attribute-object binding and serves as a indicator for how much the binding should be adjusted to address concept confusion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出两个指标，它们共同应对概念丢失和概念混淆问题。 首先，词元熵刻画了每个词元表示的集中程度，为缓解概念丢失提供了有用的线索。 其次，L0 注意力分数能够有效捕捉属性-对象绑定，并作为衡量应调整多少绑定以应对概念混淆的指标。

paragraphs.en: We propose TIE, inference-time framework that enhances text-image alignment via a single-step embedding update using AEP and IEB. paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have advanced remarkably, enabling the generation of realistic images from a given prompt [ 28 , 33 , 9 , 45 ] . To generate text conditional images, T2I diffusion models integrate embeddings from a text encoder into the denoising network through mechanisms such as cross-attention [ 35 , 30 , 22 , 27 , 6 ] . However, they often struggle to preserve the semantic alignment between prompts and generated images when multiple objects or attributes are involved [ 30 , 7 , 20 , 32 ] .

paragraphs.en: Prior methods improve compositional generation by intervening in the diffusion sampling process. A&E [ 4 ] pioneered sampling-time cross-attention modification, while SynGen [ 31 ] and EBAMA [ 46 ] enhance concept binding through attention alignment and energy-based guidance. InitNO [ 14 ] instead optimizes the initial noise, and CONFORM [ 26 ] employs a contrastive objective to improve generation fidelity. More recently, TACA [ 25 ] rebalances cross-modal attention in MM-DiTs, while FOCUS [ 3 ] steers flow-matching dynamics through stochastic optimal control. Despite their effectiveness, these methods incur additional sampling-time computation, limiting their practical efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的方法通过干预扩散采样过程来提升组合式生成。 A&E [4] 开创了在采样时修改交叉注意力的做法，而 SynGen [31] 和 EBAMA [46] 则通过注意力对齐与基于能量的引导来增强概念绑定。 InitNO [14] 转而优化初始噪声，CONFORM [26] 则采用对比目标来提升生成保真度。 最近，TACA [25] 在 MM-DiT 中重新平衡跨模态注意力，而 FOCUS [3] 则通过随机最优控制来引导流匹配动力学。 尽管这些方法行之有效，但它们会带来额外的采样时计算开销，限制了其实际效率。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work aims to improve the CLIP text embeddings [ 29 ] , which is widely used but tends to capture broad semantic meanings while missing fine-grained details [ 43 , 37 ] . In addition, it is necessary to address the problem that the CLIP text encoder is biased toward objects mentioned earlier in a sentence [ 2 , 1 ] . Magnet [ 47 ] explores modifying only the text embeddings to enhance semantic coherence. ToMe [ 15 ] and TeeMo [ 36 ] further refine embedding representations by investigating token merging and geometric properties, respectively. However, such embedding-based approaches tend to show weaker text-image alignment compared to cross-attention-based ones. In this paper, we analyze the characteristics of the commonly used CLIP text encoder and its embeddings, and explore the potential of embedding-based methods.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线旨在改进 CLIP 文本嵌入 [ 29 ]，该嵌入被广泛使用，但往往只捕捉宽泛的语义含义，而缺失细粒度细节 [ 43 , 37 ]。 此外，还有必要解决 CLIP 文本编码器偏向句子中较早提及的对象这一问题 [ 2 , 1 ]。 Magnet [ 47 ] 探索仅修改文本嵌入以增强语义一致性。 ToMe [ 15 ] 和 TeeMo [ 36 ] 分别通过研究词元合并和几何性质，进一步改进嵌入表示。 然而，与基于交叉注意力的方法相比，此类基于嵌入的方法往往表现出较弱的文本-图像对齐能力。 在本文中，我们分析了常用的 CLIP 文本编码器及其嵌入的特性，并探索基于嵌入的方法的潜力。

paragraphs.en: A recent line of work improves semantic binding by post-training the generative model itself with reinforcement learning [ 23 , 42 , 13 ] . These methods apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-style optimization to diffusion and flow-matching backbones, directly optimizing text–image alignment with reward signals and achieving strong compositional generation performance. They operate on the denoising network while keeping the text encoder fixed, whereas our method modifies the text conditioning itself without any training. Such reward-based post-training and our approach therefore address different stages of the generation pipeline and can be applied in a complementary manner in future work.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的一系列工作通过强化学习对生成模型本身进行后训练来改进语义绑定 [23, 42, 13]。 这些方法将组相对策略优化（GRPO）风格的优化应用于扩散和流匹配骨干网络，直接利用奖励信号优化文本–图像对齐，并取得了强大的组合生成性能。 这些方法作用于去噪网络而保持文本编码器固定，而我们的方法直接修改文本条件本身，无需任何训练。 因此，这类基于奖励的后训练与我们的方法作用于生成流水线的不同阶段，未来可以以互补的方式结合使用。

paragraphs.en: CLIP text encoders [ 29 ] , widely used in text-to-image (T2I) models, provide rich textual representations but often fail to preserve fine-grained compositional information [ 43 , 37 ] . Such failures can lead to concept loss , where a requested concept is not faithfully rendered, and concept confusion , where attributes are associated with the wrong objects [ 44 , 19 , 26 ] . To understand these failures within the text encoder, we identify two internal signals: token entropy as a proxy for concept-loss propensity (Section 3.1 ) and L0 attention as a signal of attribute–object binding strength (Section 3.2 ). For controlled analysis, we first study simple multi-attribute prompts. Because both quantities are computed solely from text-encoder representations, the same measurements can be applied to longer and syntactically more complex prompts.
paragraphs.zh: CLIP 文本编码器 [ 29 ] 广泛应用于文生图（T2I）模型中，能够提供丰富的文本表示，但往往无法保留细粒度的组合信息 [ 43 , 37 ] 。 这些失败可能导致概念丢失，即所请求的概念未被忠实呈现；以及概念混淆，即属性与错误的对象相关联 [ 44 , 19 , 26 ] 。 为了在文本编码器内部理解这些失败，我们识别出两个内部信号：以词元熵作为概念丢失倾向的代理指标（第 3.1 节），以及以 L0 注意力作为属性-对象绑定强度的信号（第 3.2 节）。 为了进行受控分析，我们首先研究简单的多属性提示。 由于这两个量都仅从文本编码器的表示计算得出，因此同样的测量方法可以应用于更长、句法更复杂的提示。

paragraphs.en: T2I diffusion models [ 28 , 33 ] typically consist of a text encoder and a denoising network. We focus on models using the CLIP text encoders adopted in the Stable Diffusion family [ 28 , 33 , 9 ] . Given an input prompt 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , the CLIP text encoder τ \tau produces text embeddings under causal self-attention, such that token i i attends only to tokens at positions j ≤ i j\leq i . The resulting representation is C = τ ⁡ ( 𝒫 ) ∈ ℝ N × M C=\tau(\mathcal{P})\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times M} , where N N is the number of tokens and M M is the embedding dimension. Padding is used to obtain a fixed sequence length.
paragraphs.zh: 文生图（T2I）扩散模型 [28, 33] 通常由一个文本编码器和一个去噪网络组成。 我们关注使用 Stable Diffusion 系列 [28, 33, 9] 所采用的 CLIP 文本编码器的模型。 给定输入提示 𝒫，CLIP 文本编码器 τ 在因果自注意力机制下生成文本嵌入，即第 i 个词元仅关注位置 j ≤ i 的词元。 所得的表示为 C = τ(𝒫) ∈ ℝ^(N×M)，其中 N 是词元数量，M 是嵌入维度。 填充用于获得固定的序列长度。

paragraphs.en: Understanding which text representations are vulnerable to concept loss is a necessary first step toward correcting them. Previous work [ 5 ] shows that objects mentioned later in a prompt are more likely to disappear from generated images, revealing a positional bias associated with CLIP’s causal text encoding. We first examine whether a similar positional effect occurs for attributes and then ask whether an internal property of the corresponding token embeddings can serve as a proxy for such failures.
paragraphs.zh: 理解哪些文本表示容易受到概念丢失的影响，是纠正它们的第一步必要工作。 先前的工作 [ 5 ] 表明，在提示中较晚提及的物体更可能从生成的图像中消失，这揭示了与 CLIP 的因果文本编码相关的一种位置偏差。 我们首先检验属性是否也存在类似的位置效应，然后探究相应词元嵌入的某种内部属性是否可以作为此类失败的代理指标。

paragraphs.en: We sample prompts of the form "a ⟨ \langle attr ⟩ 1 {}_{1}\rangle ⟨ \langle obj ⟩ 1 {}_{1}\rangle and a ⟨ \langle attr ⟩ 2 {}_{2}\rangle ⟨ \langle obj ⟩ 2 {}_{2}\rangle " from Concept Conjunction 500 (CC-500) [ 11 ] and retain 220 generated images in which both objects are present. For each image, we manually categorize the attribute associated with each object as Aligned , Misaligned , or Missing . As shown in Fig. 2 a, the later-mentioned attribute–object pair exhibits substantially more missing and misaligned attributes than the earlier pair. Thus, the positional bias previously observed for objects also manifests in attribute rendering. This observation alone, however, cannot determine whether a particular prompt is prone to concept loss. We therefore examine the geometry of individual token embeddings.

paragraphs.en: Finally, we measure whether entropy is associated with actual rendering failures. Using the setting of Fig. 2 a, we compare token entropy across correctly and incorrectly rendered concepts. As shown in Fig. 2 c, for both attributes and objects, entropy is higher when the requested concept is misaligned, mixed, or missing than when it is correctly rendered. The relationship also persists at the prompt level. Mean concept entropy increases as rendering deteriorates from both concepts being present to one or neither being present, and concept loss frequency rises substantially across entropy quantiles. At the individual-concept level, token entropy provides a graded signal of susceptibility to concept loss rather than a discrete prediction. We therefore use it to adapt the strength of embedding preservation for each concept, assigning stronger intervention to representations with higher entropy. Additional predictive-validity, calibration, and causal-intervention results are provided in the supplementary material.

paragraphs.en: Motivated by observations that different Transformer layers play distinct functional roles [ 40 , 41 , 8 ] , we instead examine self-attention throughout the CLIP text encoder. We selectively mask the key of an attribute token at individual self-attention layers and inspect its effect on generation. paragraphs.en: We next examine whether L0 attention between attribute and object tokens provides a continuous signal of their binding relationship. As shown in Fig. 3 c, before controlling for token distance, related and unrelated pairs are strongly separable, with AUCs of 0.980 0.980 for CLIP-L and 0.965 0.965 for CLIP-G. paragraphs.en: Our method is motivated by the two key indicators derived from Section 3 : token entropy for concept loss and L0 attention score for concept confusion. We improve T2I generation in multi-object and multi-attribute scenarios by integrating two complementary components as shown in Fig. 4 . To address concept loss, we first implement Adaptive Embedding Preservation (AEP), which exploits the tendency of tokens with higher token entropy. After recovering lost concepts, we mitigate concept confusion through Interpolation Extrapolation Binding (IEB), which estimates concept binding strength based on L0 attention scores.

paragraphs.en: To preserve concepts that are more prone to concept loss using individual token embeddings, we introduce AEP. This method selectively amplifies concept token embeddings with end-of-text (EOT) tokens using entropy-aware singular value decomposition (SVD). Prior work has shown that EOT tokens also encode semantic information crucial for concept composition [ 47 , 38 ] . Our AEP jointly strengthens explicit concept token embeddings and EOT tokens according to their entropy, successfully mitigating concept loss.

paragraphs.en: After addressing concept loss through AEP, we now propose the Interpolation–Extrapolation Binding (IEB) mechanism to resolve concept confusion, ensuring that the relationships between concepts are accurately reflected in the generated image, as illustrated in Fig. 4 c. Inspired by prior studies indicating that CLIP text embeddings exhibit compositional structure [ 39 ] , we incorporate concept tokens to both attribute and object tokens bidirectionally to bring their embeddings closer. In contrast, we extrapolate unrelated concepts by pushing them further apart. To reflect binding strength between tokens, IEB leverages the L0 attention score introduced in Section 3.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在通过 AEP 解决概念缺失问题之后，我们现在提出插值-外推绑定（IEB）机制来解决概念混淆，确保概念之间的关系能够准确地反映在生成的图像中，如图 4c 所示。 受先前研究表明 CLIP 文本嵌入具有组合结构 [39] 的启发，我们将概念 token 与属性 token 和对象 token 进行双向结合，使其嵌入彼此更加接近。 相反，我们通过将无关概念推得更远来进行外推。 为了反映 token 之间的绑定强度，IEB 利用了第 3.2 节中引入的 L0 注意力分数。

paragraphs.en: We employ the BLIP-VQA metric from T2I-CompBench [ 17 ] for evaluation. This metric utilizes BLIP for visual question answering, enabling fine-grained assessment of attributes in the generated images. Following prior works [ 15 , 36 , 12 , 16 , 18 ] , we evaluate the Color, Shape, and Texture categories, and further include the Complex and Spatial categories for a more comprehensive evaluation. For each category, we evaluate all 300 benchmark prompts and generate five images per prompt using five fixed random seeds. Inference time is measured on an RTX A6000 GPU with a batch size of 1. Additional results using other metrics and datasets are provided in the supplementary material.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Tab. 1 , we compare TIE with baselines built on the SDXL and SD3.5 backbones. For SDXL, our method achieves superior performance across all categories compared to other baseline models. We exclude ToMe [ 15 ] from the spatial category evaluation as it is specifically designed for attribute binding and does not incorporate spatial structure in its token merging process. For SD3.5-Medium, TIE achieves the best performance on Color, Shape, and Texture, outperforming recent baselines including FOCUS and TACA, while remaining competitive on Spatial and Complex prompts. TIE also achieves strong performance on SD3.5-Large, demonstrating consistent gains across model scales. Overall, these results demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates concept confusion and prevents concept loss with minimal overhead.

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image diffusion models struggle with multi-concept prompts. We find that token entropy predicts concept loss, while L0 attention captures attribute–object binding. We propose TIE, a training-free framework combining entropy-aware singular value amplification (AEP) and L0-attention-based binding (IEB) in a single embedding update. TIE mitigates concept loss and confusion, improving compositional alignment across SDXL and SD3.5 without training or model modifications.
